question: The population of a district is 351000, out of which 164000 are males. 14% of the population is literate. If 14% males are literate, then what percentage of females are literate?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the overall percentage of a group matches the percentage of one of its sub-groups (males), the other sub-group (females) must have the exact same percentage.

Let the female literacy rate be x%.

14% of Total = 14% of Males + x% of Females

14% of (Males + Females) = 14% of Males + x% of Females ⇒ x = 14%

**∴ The correct answer is 14%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total population = 351000

Number of males = 164000

Overall literacy rate = 14%

Male literacy rate = 14%
